mechanisms.reading: Three deferred cheques secure rent only until a standing bank order is arranged; their stated return trigger is that arrangement. A separate fixed-amount security cheque covers several obligations and has no equally explicit return trigger here.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Treat all four cheques as one deposit, count three extra rent months, or carry the clause 6 return trigger over to clause 13.
mechanisms.correction: Keep instrument instances, scope and return events distinct. Neither delivery nor return is established by the printed requirement.

mechanisms.reading: Unlike template-only option mentions, clause 9 grants a one-year option subject to performance and written notice ninety days before term end. The printed reviewed clauses do not state the next year's rent.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Discard the actual option as a ghost, presume its exercise, or automatically carry the original rent into the further year.
mechanisms.correction: Record the conditional option and leave exercise and future price unresolved, including any effect of the missing incorporated draft.
unresolved: draft text and any price term

mechanisms.reading: An early departure provision preserves payment through the term; a separate replacement route requires written notice at least three months ahead and a reasonably acceptable candidate taking all terms and security duties.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Apply the general payment rule without the special route or treat nomination alone as automatic release of payment and existing instruments.
mechanisms.correction: Distinguish notice, candidate approval, new obligation, possession and security exchange.

mechanisms.reading: A general entire-agreement term excludes earlier external understandings, while a specific clause expressly incorporates an earlier signed draft whose text was not supplied.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Declare all earlier terms excluded or invent the incorporated draft's content from a different contract.
mechanisms.correction: Preserve the specific reference and mark the incorporated document as missing; do not infer which terms prevail without its text.
unresolved: how it interacts with the present clauses

mechanisms.reading: Ninety days before term end concerns option notice, three months concerns replacement notice, and seventy-two hours after posting concerns presumed postal delivery.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Merge the two advance periods or treat postal delivery time as an option or replacement cure period.
mechanisms.correction: Bind each duration to its own action, trigger and method of notice.

mechanisms.reading: A broad condition acknowledgment and damage wording coexist with return duties and a security cheque also covering unpaid charges. The printed terms do not prove a defect, causation, unpaid bill or right to cash a cheque in a particular event.
mechanisms.initial_error_hypothesis: Use AS IS or possession of security as proof of tenant-caused damage or debt, or turn a broad waiver into a legal validity conclusion.
mechanisms.correction: Separate the written duty, actual state, causation, bills and realization procedure; leave external law to a dated source review.
